fixtures.origin: Synthetic AIXM 5.1.1 documents hand-written on 2026-09-21 for a reading the harness fixtures cannot carry or that deserves its own file: the EPSG:4326 / CRS84 axis-order pair (the same numbers, two places), an interior ring of curves (too deep for a shipped twin), a composition with a cycle of contributor references, every reference form, twelve ways of stating a vertical limit, nil / absent / withdrawn property states, and a schema-valid BASELINE with a TimeInstant that breaks Temporality Concept rule TS_001. Read by name in `tests/test_cdm_aixm511_adapter.py`; every one validates against the pinned XSD (BLOCKED when the resource is absent). Fictitious identifiers and positions throughout.
